literal_meaning: তুম্ববৎ স্ফীত; টই=ঘরের চালের মটকা এবং তুম্ব=লাউয়ের শুকনো খোস
figurative_meaning_en: full to the brim, completely full or overflowing
example_sentences_in_bangla: জল খেয়ে তার পেট টইটম্বুর হয়ে গেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: His stomach became full to bursting after drinking water.
The pond overflows with water during the rainy season.
The lychees look full to the brim with juice.
note: The idiom draws from traditional rural Bengali household items like roof pots (টই) and dried gourd shells (তুম্ব), evoking images of natural swelling and fullness.
